title: A HIT CLOSES THE MAP AND THE BACKPACK
why: His notes of 2026-10-09: if you have the map open and take damage, the map should close, and the same for the backpack. A hit that lands now shuts both, so the fight is on screen the moment it reaches you. An item you were dragging in the backpack goes back where it was, as it does when you press ESC. A hit that does not land (while you are briefly protected) leaves them open.
now: Taking a hit now closes the map and the backpack, so you see the fight at once.
